name: Droid Bionic

images.credit: Jabartlett7, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: CDMA 800/1900 MHz EVDO Rev. A, 700 MHz 4G LTE, 802.11b/g/n

Platform.Operating system: Official: Android 2.3.4 Gingerbread, upgradable to Android 4.1.2 Jelly Bean (with Motorola Application Platform) , Unofficial: Android 7.1 Nougat via LineageOS 14.1
Platform.CPU: 1 GHz dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 SoC processor; TI OMAP4430 (1.2 GHz after ICS update)

Memory.RAM: 16 GB flash memory, 1 GB LP DDR2 RAM
Memory.Card slot: 16 GB pre-installed microSD card. Supports up to 32 GB microSD

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth v2.1 + EDR, HDMI, 3.5 mm TRRS audio jack, Micro USB, DLNA
